Mandala Racquet Club

Mandala Club Singapore

THE MANDALA IS A COMMUNITY OF COMMUNITIES.

An affiliated collective of places and spaces created for a discerning, sophisticated and astute group.

​

Those who value the Mandala’s unique philosophy appreciate the consistency we deliver across everything we do—expect seamlessly curated and impeccable service, insistence on respect for purpose, place, responsible citizenship and sustainability.

​

Put simply, a canvas for the company you want to keep.

​

Life is an adventure. Or, at least, we at Mandala Club, would like to think it is. And we also think that an adventure is best experienced with great people in great environments.

​

Which is why we make such extraordinary efforts to create a community that inspires meaningful moments, and to make connections that matter. All while having a fabulous time.

DISCOVER

Enter the stunning heritage shop front of Mandala, where two distinct spaces set the tone for your day.. and night.

​

By day, The Members Bar is bathed in natural light—a sophisticated setting for morning catch-ups, long lunches, or martini-fuelled meetings. As the sun sets, the energy shifts, The Velvet Room comes to life behind velvet-drapes—a low-lit, mood-rich enclave made for mischief and nights that run late.

THE MEMBERS BAR
& THE VELVET ROOM
 

The heartbeat of the Club, POPI's is our social, vibrant, fun, stylish and even eccentric place to be, where you can experience great food, drinks, art & music. Off the side of our casual dining restaurant, you'll find our purpose-built Analogue Room, complete with a 1960s analogue sound system and enviable vintage record collection.

 

Plus, tucked just beyond the buzz is SIDEBAR—a stylish, spirited hideaway designed for pre-dinner aperitifs, late-night rendezvous, or intimate celebrations.

POPI'S, THE SIDEBAR
& THE ANALOGUE ROOM

The main dining room on Level 3 is The Parlour—a reimagined space designed for day-to-night living at the Club. Open from morning through late, The Parlour will offer a flexible work and lounge environment, a rotating fresh salad bar for light, nourishing lunches, and a full Club Menu of Mandala favourites—comforting, familiar, and satisfying.

 

Plus, tucked away in a corner is BAR MORI—the Club’s newest Japanese concept: part izakaya, part disco daydream, and all kinds of delicious, serving up classics including fresh sashimi, signature rolls, and elevated small plates that pair perfectly with your evening pour.

THE PARLOUR, THE DEN & BAR MORI

Rebalancing our bodies, minds and spirits with some restorative sustenance, replenishing treatments, spiritual restitution and time for quiet reflection is something all we need now and then.

 

At Mandala Club, we take our members' overall well-being very seriously, so much so that we converted the attic into an intelligent, holistic and all-sensory gym and wellness space, complete with state-of-the-art facilities and group classes and personal training sessions in collaboration with 2100 Performance.

THE GYM

Mandala Club has expanded next door—the 9,000 square foot extension of the Club's livelihood and soul offers two unique floors available as event spaces, each designed to host a wide range of curated events that cater to the most discerning clientele.


From luxury brand activations and wellness experiences to exclusive nightlife parties, the newest extension provides versatile spaces for unforgettable experiences in an elevated, private setting.

A MULTI-FACETED EVENT SPACE FOR EXCLUSIVE EXPERIENCES

A minimalist, premium “white box” venue, equipped with top-tier inbuilt AV and a wet bar, ideal for dry hires, brand launches, and curated private events.

THE BALLROOM

An extension of the heart of the Club, this vibrant space pulses with energy and personality. Bold design meets a spirit of spontaneity with its distinctive DNA and ever-evolving atmosphere.

POPI'S PENTHOUSE

RACE WEEK HQ

Taking you off the track, and inside the race.

Insider Access
THE MEMBERS BAR

The sun-drenched social hub is perfect for coffee-fuelled mornings, working lunches, or a spontaneous martini at noon. From breakfast through to dinner, The Members Bar delivers a bold take on classic comfort with elevated eats.
 

POPI'S

A vibrant dining destination at the heart of the Club where great food, art and conversation come together. From the open show kitchen to the garden terrace, POPI's serves bold, Mediterranean-inspired flavours in a stylish yet relaxed setting for those long lunches and leisurely dinners.

THE PARLOUR

Thoughtfully reimagined for relaxed productivity and easy comfort, The Parlour is a flexible space designed for working, lounging, and casual connection. Enjoy nourishing lunches from a rotating salad bar, or settle in with comforting Club favourites from the Club menu.

BAR MORI

Meet the Club's new Japanese concept: part izakaya, part disco daydream, and all kinds of delicious.

 

Serving up classics including fresh sashimi, signature rolls, and elevated small plates that pair perfectly with your evening pour.

TASTE

AN EVENING WITH JAPAN'S SEA WOMEN

21 October 2026 at 7:00:00 pm

Join us for an intimate evening with ama free-diver Risa Matsumoto and Shinto expert Yuko Muraguchi. Discover their revered coastal traditions, taste hand-crafted sea salt, and enjoy an Ise-Shima-inspired menu.

LOST IN TRANSLATION

20 October 2026 at 7:00:00 pm

Join us as panelists including NUS Professor Lionel Wee and member Chathuni Uduwela dissect the invisible friction between global technology and local culture, exploring how Western AI models miss Asia’s high-context nuances.

VINYL LISTENING SESSION: 100 YEARS OF JOHN COLTRANE

14 October 2026 at 7:30:00 pm

Co-hosted by fellow member JJ Tan and curator Rupert England, this vinyl listening session marks John Coltrane’s centennial. Trace his journey from sideman to visionary bandleader, culminating in his spiritual jazz masterpiece, A Love Supreme.

UNDERSTANDING ADHD IN WOMEN

29 October 2026 at 6:30:00 pm

Join us for an eye-opening, compassionate panel discussion designed specifically for women who suspect they may have ADHD—whether you're formally diagnosed or simply recognise yourself in the stories no one ever told you growing up. Cut through the noise to gain clarity, language, and understanding you've been searching for.

THE AWAKENING JOURNEY

24 October 2026 at 10:30:00 am

A transformational breathwork experience designed to activate self-awareness, expand consciousness, and reconnect you with your true nature. This journey is an invitation to wake up to who you are beneath conditioning, patterns, and limitations. To move beyond autopilot living and into a deeper sense of presence, clarity, and inner knowing.

QUESTIONS YOU NEVER GET TO ASK YOUR DOCTOR

27 October 2026 at 7:00:00 pm

Join Dr. Jonathan Foo and Dr. Jesse Hu of The Aeden Surgeons for an intimate, candid evening designed to strip away the clinical jargon and hype. Grounded in real-world case studies and science, this is your rare opportunity to engage in an honest, unfiltered conversation about your health—over good drink and even better company.

SATURDAY SUPPER CLUB

3 October 2026 at 7:30:00 pm

Ease into the night with an elegant evening of flavour and flow—dinner, drinks, and live music to start. Whether you’re staying for a set or settling in for the night, the atmosphere is yours to shape.

RACE WEEK HOSPITALITY

10 October 2026 at 5:00:00 pm

Two days of race-week action, good food and drinks flowing at the Club. Settle in for Singapore’s biggest racing weekend, with every moment of the action live on screen, exceptional plates you keep you fueled, and drinks at the ready.

AN EVENING WITH HENRY MOODIE

1 October 2026 at 6:00:00 pm

Join Henry Moodie for an intimate fireside chat as he shares 10 songs that shaped his journey, with stories behind the music and the artist.

BOOGIE PASOH: ELECTRIC EDEN

9 October 2026 at 8:00:00 pm

Race Weekend starts here. Step into a tropical fever dream of after-dark jungle, hypnotic rhythms and low-lit corners—one electric night made for losing track of time, with free-flow sips from 8–9PM to keep the drinks and the energy going.

THE PRICE OF PARADISE

28 October 2026 at 7:00:00 pm

Join F. Sander for an intimate fireside conversation exploring the moral compromises behind the “good life”, the strange relationship between privilege and responsibility, and what happens when we are finally forced to confront the human cost of our own happiness. Part fiction, part philosophy, and very much a conversation about the present.

FIRST POUR

15 October 2026 at 6:30:00 pm

An evening designed for new (and old) members to mix, mingle, and get to know the community, the Membership team, and the Community team. Think of it as your first step into your home away from home. Share stories, spark connections, and settle into the rhythm of Club life.

PROUDLY PITCH A FRIEND

22 October 2026 at 7:00:00 pm

Pitch a friend, flirt a little, or just enjoy the queer chaos. Forget the apps; your friends know your "type" better than an algorithm ever will. Hosted by member and seasoned Pitcher Jadey Hurley, we’re bringing back the art of the wingman for a high-stakes, hilarious night of matchmaking.

THE BIG BAD BRUNCH CLUB: RACE WEEK EDITION

10 October 2026 at 12:00:00 pm

As Race Week HQ brings the world of racing beyond the circuit and into the Club, the engines are revving and the tables are loaded. Singapore’s biggest weekend calls for a brunch to match.

9DMT TRIP

10 October 2026 at 10:30:00 am

A deeply immersive breathwork experience designed to guide you into expanded states of consciousness, helping you reconnect with yourself on a profound emotional and subconscious level.

THE LONG GAME: MAKING IT IN MOTORSPORT

8 October 2026 at 6:30:00 pm

Singapore’s first Formula One academy driver Kabir Anurag joins former Formula 3 racer and Stratos Motorsports Group founder Daniel Woodroof for a candid conversation about what it really takes to build a lasting career in racing.

LATIN FIESTA WITH MARTIN REYES

17 October 2026 at 7:00:00 pm

Guests will enjoy a dynamic journey through Latin sounds from salsa and Latin pop to global hits designed to encourage connection, movement, and celebration. This edition will also feature a special Salsa School Performance, adding an extra visual and cultural highlight to the evening.

BPM

2 October 2026 at 9:00:00 pm

Move to the sound of Hip Hop & R&B with late-night grooves designed to carry you from first drink to last call.

B-SIDES

1 October 2026 at 7:00:00 pm

Join us for our weekly Thursday night ritual celebrating sound, energy, and the moments that turn one drink into another.

FROM GRID TO GLOBAL: BUILDING ASIA'S MOTORSPORT ECOSYSTEM

9 October 2026 at 6:30:00 pm

Alexandre Gibot (Managing Director, Porsche Motorsport Asia Pacific) and Jazeman Jaafar (Driving Standards Advisor, Porsche Carrera Cup Asia) explore what it takes to turn Asia’s growing enthusiasm for motorsport into a sustainable pipeline of world-class drivers, engineers and racing teams.

BEYOND THE GRID FIRESIDE CHAT, PRESENTED BY IM8

7 October 2026 at 3:00:00 pm

Discover the extraordinary human performance behind the F1 spectacle: a grid session as part of Race Week HQ.

SHAKE, STIR, POUR

7 October 2026 at 5:30:00 pm

A rotating exploration of spirits, techniques, and the finer points of the pour behind the bar. Pull up a stool and learn tips of the trade from our bartenders, while savouring our personal picks of the shelf. Come thirsty.

SUNDAY LUNCH AT THE CLUB

5 October 2026 at 12:00:00 pm

Join us for a delightful Sunday Family Lunch where kids eat FREE! Savor a delicious selection of mains, including Slow Cooked Westholme Wagyu Tri-tip, Braised Lamb Shank, or Half Roasted Chicken.
While you enjoy your meal, the little ones can have a blast with fun activities. A perfect way to spend quality time with family!

TWIST, PULL, POP

6 October 2026 at 5:30:00 pm

Your weekly excuse to drink better wine. Experience an intimate wine tasting in The Cellar with the Sommelier team, where you'll hear the stories behind each bottle, sample a curated selection of our favourite labels, and sharpen your own taste in fine wines.

BUILDING THE NEXT CHAPTER – TGR HASS F1 TEAM

6 October 2026 at 6:30:00 pm

A conversation on leadership with the Team Principal of TGR Haas F1 Team: a grid session as part of Race Week HQ.

DECODING THE MIND-BODY CONNECTION

28 October 2026 at 7:00:00 pm

Join us as fellow member Mae Kwan reveals how high performance can mask survival mode, guiding us through chakra balancing and EFT tapping to heal physical stress and release stored trauma.

MANDALA RUN CLUB

1 October 2026 at 7:00:00 am

Co-hosted by fellow member Jerome Lamirand, this relaxed morning run every Thurs is all about starting the day with good energy, easy conversation, and even better company. Whether you’re looking to get your steps in, meet fellow members, or simply enjoy a refreshing run through the city, this is the perfect way to ease into your morning.

THE DESIGN SALON

15 October 2026 at 5:00:00 pm

The Design Salon – Edition 02: Build / Bridge is a specially curated evening by the DesignSingapore Council that brings Singapore’s tech and design communities together.

THE COMPLETE MANDALA RACQUET CLUB EXPERIENCE

The outdoor grounds of Mandala Racquet Club will soon welcome members, bringing together sport, recovery, leisure and dining in one seamless destination by the sea.

Alongside our indoor padel courts, members can enjoy a dedicated wellness suite featuring an indoor ice plunge, hot plunge and thermal sauna, an outdoor padel court overlooking the coast, a swimming pool framed by parasols and daybeds, and a children's playground designed for younger members and families.

​

Coming soon.

2100 PERFORMANCE X MANDALA CLUB

As the Club's official Health & Wellness partner, we welcome 2100 Performance, our new fitness partner. 2100 Performance is a longevity-focused practice with personalised training protocols built around the biology of the individual member, continuously adapted as the data moves. The horizon is decades, not weeks.

MEET BAR MORI

Tucked away in a corner of Level 3 sits BAR MORI—the Club's sushi & sake bar and a high-energy space serving up fresh sashimi, signature rolls, and elevated small plates designed to pair

beautifully with your evening pour.

​

Set against a backdrop of hand-carved wood, walk down the neon sign-lined hallway into a space that pulses with a retro-futurist charm. As the night deepens, the mic comes out. Our newly-installed karaoke system transforms the space into your stage for dinner, drinks, and a little debauchery.

DYSON X MANDALA CLUB

Mandala members can now enjoy Dyson’s latest innovations throughout the Gym changing rooms—a complete refresh designed to enhance your post-workout routine with cutting-edge technology and iconic hair tools.

 

Discover the next generation of Dyson styling tools, engineered for performance, protection, and a seamless member experience at the Club.
